title: System operator contacts at a glance
content:
Every company is free to choose a system operator to conclude a system participation agreement with. There are various options. What system operators are there, and how can you get in touch with them? Find an overview here.

Please note: The ZSVR is prohibited from offering advice, recommending system operators or sharing information about prices, but we are happy to answer specific legal questions about the interpretation of the Verpackungsgesetz (Packaging Act). Providing (legal) consulting services on an individual basis is beyond our remit.

Are you looking to conclude a system participation agreement and are struggling with options, costs and the contents of the contract? Then please turn to one of the following system operators directly.

You can also contact a qualified expert with your questions or seek legal advice from a tax adviser, auditor or similar. The register of auditors - Division 1 contains registered experts providing this service.
